Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning assisted living facility medicaid minimum occupancy of fifty percent or greater.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to assisted living facility medicaid minimumoccupancy percentage of fifty percent or greater; adding a new sectionto chapter 74.39A RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 74.39A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department shall establish a capital addon rate, not less thanthe July 1, 2005, capital addon rate established by the department,for those assisted living facilities contracting with the departmentthat have a medicaid minimum occupancy percentage of sixty percent orgreater. The medicaid minimum occupancy percentage shall be determinedon an annual basis. In determining whether an assisted living facilitymeets the medicaid minimum occupancy percentage established under thissection, the department shall include in the calculation of medicaiddays those clients who are enrolled in a managed care delivery systemfor receipt of long-term care services, including but not limited tothe program for all inclusive care and the medicaid integrationproject.
If specific funding for the purposes of thisact, referencing this act by bill or chapter number, is not provided byJune 30, 2006, in the omnibus appropriations act, this act is null andvoid.
